title: Emit a filtered JSON array with correct item types
purpose: Tests whether the model produces a JSON array containing only the items matching a stated condition, with the correct per-item shape. Structured extraction often degrades into arrays mixing matched and unmatched items or objects with inconsistent keys; this case makes both failure modes countable while keeping the schema simple enough for deterministic verification.

evidence.text: Delivery ledger, week 32: Monday - flour, 12 sacks, delivered. Tuesday - nails, 3 crates, delayed. Wednesday - flour, 5 sacks, delivered. Thursday - glass, 9 panes, delayed. Friday - flour, 8 sacks, delivered.

instruction: You are given a delivery ledger excerpt. Return ONLY a JSON array. Each element must be an object with exactly these keys: "day" (string), "goods" (string), "quantity" (number). Include ONLY entries where the goods are flour. Do not include delayed-status commentary or any other keys. Do not wrap the array in text or fences.
constraints: Response must be a single JSON array with exactly three elements (Monday, Wednesday, Friday flour entries), each with exactly day/goods/quantity keys, quantity numeric.
expected: A single JSON array of three objects, one per delivered flour entry (Monday 12, Wednesday 5, Friday 8), each with exactly the keys day, goods, quantity, no fences or prose.
